limitations: visual_sequence is built from 9 fixed samples per legacy video; two videos edited differently between samples can produce the same string. The analysis-ready corpus is not a random sample of the niche: deep.py only ever processed reels that score.py had already ranked near the top of their creator's output, so its median robust_z is above zero by construction. Any contrast computed inside it compares strong videos with other strong videos, not strong with average (docs/M2RADAR_ANALYSIS_METHOD.md §1.4).
method: Top 10 most frequent visual_sequence strings (deduplicated consecutive frame types), with each bar's median view_lift annotated.
title: Visual sequence frequency, top 10
